metadata.dcterms:title: A FORMULA OF ARTHUR AND AFFINE HECKE ALGEBRAS
metadata.dcterms:creator: OPDAM, ERIC
SOLLEVELD, MAARTEN
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Let π, π′ be tempered representations of an aﬃne Hecke algebra with positive parameters. We study their Euler–Poincar´e pairing EP(π, π′), the alter- nating sum of the dimensions of the Ext-groups. We show that EP(π, π′) can be expressed in a simple formula involving an analytic R-group, analogous to a for- mula of Arthur in the setting of reductive p-adic groups. Our proof applies equally well to aﬃne Hecke algebras and to reductive groups over nonarchimedean local ﬁelds of arbitrary characteristic.
